These source modules, cinematic prompts and Game instructions are adapted from BesianSherifaj-AI/h3-prompt-studio at commit a6b2a91fe6f0 (MIT). The graph builder uses the upstream embedded recipes. This distribution includes the upstream license and notices. Its resources module contains only the loopback URL validator. The saved-workflow repair additionally verifies ordered native guide nodes against the active H3 latent. Third-party runtimes and models are installed separately.
